y-m-24-01.title: Uma isebenze ku-x=0 no-x=1, isebenza kuwo wonke ama-x?
y-m-24-01.topic: Ukubala ngezinhlamvu: imikhiqizo yamandla ohlamvu olufanayo, nezibonelo eziphikisayo
y-m-24-01.goal: Hlulela ukuthi ukuhlola ukuthi isisho sisebenza ezinombolweni ezimbalwa kuyibufakazi bokuthi sisebenza kuzo zonke izinombolo, futhi wenze wena isibonelo esiphikisayo futhi uchaze ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo ezenza izinhlangothi ezimbili zilingane ngenhlanhla kuphela.
y-m-24-01.material: USua wathi, "U-x²×x³ ungu-x⁶!" (Ukufunda: x squared times x cubed is x to the sixth.) USua wafaka u-0 esikhundleni sika-x futhi izinhlangothi zombili zaba ngu-0, futhi wafaka u-1 esikhundleni sika-x futhi zombili zaba ngu-1. Kulo msebenzi, u-x uyinombolo kusuka ku--5 kuya ku-5, futhi ungafaka nama-decimal.
y-m-24-01.thinking.0: Ukwahlulela ukuthi kusho ini ukuthi isibonelo sidlulile
y-m-24-01.prereq.0: Incazelo yamandla (isibonelo: u-x³ ngu-x ophindaphindwe izikhathi ezintathu)
y-m-24-01.prereq.1: Ukuthola inani lesisho ngokufaka izinombolo ezinegethivu nama-decimal esikhundleni sohlamvu
y-m-24-01.s.s1.prompt: Yini engasho ngokuhlola kukaSua (izinhlangothi zombili zafana ku-x=0 no-x=1)?
y-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubheke ukuthi izinombolo ezimbili uSua azifakile, u-0 no-1, zihluka kanjani kwezinye izinombolo.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.1: Uma ufuna ukuhlola isitatimende sikaSua, bhala izinombolo ezimbili noma ezintathu obungazifaka esikhundleni sika-x.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.a: Izinhlangothi zombili zafana ku-x=0 no-x=1, ngakho singaphetha ngokuthi sisebenza kuwo wonke ama-x
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.a: Uphendule impumelelo emibili waba u-'isebenza kuzo zonke izinombolo'. Noma izibonelo ezimbalwa zisebenza, lokho akuba u-'konke'.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.b: Izinhlangothi zombili zafana ku-x=0 no-x=1, kodwa asikazi ukuthi zifana yini kwezinye ama-x
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu ukucabanga kokwahlulela ngaphandle kokudlula ububanzi izibonelo ezihloliwe eziwuhlanganisayo. Ukuthi uzofaka u-x muni olandelayo kuba yinto ebalulekile.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.c: Izinhlangothi zombili zafana ku-x=0 no-x=1, ngakho singaphetha ngokuthi isebenza njalo uma u-x ephozithivu
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.c: Unciphise u-'konke' waba u-'iphozithivu', kodwa uhlole kuphela inombolo eyodwa ephozithivu, u-1. Ukunciphisa ububanzi akwengezi ubufakazi.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.o.d: Izinhlangothi zombili zafana ku-x=0 no-x=1, ngakho kuvele ubufakazi bokuthi isitatimende sikaSua siphosile
y-m-24-01.s.s1.r.d: Ufunde umphumela ofanayo njengobufakazi bohlangothi oluphambene. Lokhu kuhlola akuyona ubufakazi bokuthi kuphosile nakho.
y-m-24-01.s.s1.explain: Iqiniso lokuthi amanani amabili ayefana liqinisekiswa kuphela kulawo manani amabili. Ukufuna isibonelo esiphula isitatimende, udinga ukuhlola u-x ngaphandle kuka-0 no-1.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.prompt: Thola futhi ufake amanani angu-3 ahlukile ka-x lapho u-x²×x³ no-x⁶ banamanani ahlukile. (U-x ungu--5 kuya ku-5)
y-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.0: Faka u-2 esikhundleni sika-x futhi ubale u-x²×x³ no-x⁶ ngokuhlukile.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.1: Uma uhlangabezana nenombolo enika inani elifanayo, shintshela kwenye inombolo futhi ubale. Ungazama futhi izinombolo ezinegethivu nama-decimal.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Sicela wenze u-x abe yinombolo kusuka ku--5 kuya ku-5.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Amanani ka-x²×x³ no-x⁶ ahlukile. Kuyisibonelo esiphula isitatimende sikaSua.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kulo x, izinhlangothi ezimbili ziyafana. Akusona isibonelo esiphula isitatimende sikaSua.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, uma u-x=2, x²×x³=4×8=32 no-x⁶=64, ahlukile. Uma u-x=-1, angu--1 no-1, futhi uma u-x=0.5, angu-0.03125 no-0.015625, ahlukile. Ama-x kuphela lapho izinhlangothi ezimbili zifana ngu-0 no-1, ngakho uSua ukhethe ngenhlanhla izinombolo ezimbili ezenza zifane.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Tshela uSua. Bhala ukuthi kungani zazifana ngenhlanhla ku-x=0 no-x=1, uSua azihlolile, nokuthi kungani zihluka kwezinye izinombolo.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ungalethe u-x owamthola ngenhla nomphumela wokubala kwakhe futhi uwusebenzise njengoba unjalo.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bhala wena ukuthi kwenzekani enanini uma uthatha amandla ka-0 no-1.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.placeholder: Isibonelo: noma uthatha amandla ka-0 noma 1, ... ngakho ...
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ubhale ngamazwi akho ukuthi kungani ukufaka u-0 noma 1 kuphela akuphuli isitatimende?
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Unikeze okungenani u-x oyedwa ophula isitatimende, ngezinombolo?
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.model.0: U-0 no-1 bahlala beyi-0 no-1 noma ubaphindaphinda izikhathi ezingaki, ngakho izinhlangothi zombili zazifana ngenhlanhla. Uma ufaka u-2, u-x²×x³ ungu-32 kodwa u-x⁶ ungu-64, ngakho bahlukile. Ngakho ukuthola ezimbili ezilungile akusho ukuthi kulungile njalo.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Zifana kuphela ku-x=0 no-x=1, futhi zihlukile kwezinye izinombolo. Uma u-x engu-2, 4×8=32 no-2⁶=64, ngakho azifani. U-x²×x³ ngu-x ophindaphindwe izikhathi ezinhlanu futhi u-x⁶ ngu-x ophindaphindwe izikhathi eziyisithupha, ngakho inani lezikhathi ophindaphindwa ngalo lihlukile.
y-m-24-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Indlela echaza ngenani lezikhathi u-x aphindaphindwa ngalo nayo ilungile.

y-m-24-02.title: Izinhlelo zokuqasha amabhayisikili: yiluphi olushibhile uma ugibela isikhathi eside?
y-m-24-02.topic: Ukusebenzisa imisebenzi yomugqa: ukuqhathanisa izisho ezimbili zamanani
y-m-24-02.goal: Buyekeza isahlulelo sakho ngokulandelana kokukhula kwedatha, futhi ubhale isaziso esinemibandela esekelwe esikhathini lapho amanani ezisho ezimbili zomugqa elingana khona.
y-m-24-02.material: Isiteshi somphakathi sokuqasha amabhayisikili sinezinhlelo ezimbili zamanani. Uhlelo A lunenani eliyisisekelo elingu-1000원 futhi lwengeza u-150원 ngomzuzu ngamunye, futhi uhlelo B lunenani eliyisisekelo elingu-400원 futhi lwengeza u-200원 ngomzuzu ngamunye. Isikhathi sokugibela sibalwa ngamayunithi emizuzu engu-1, futhi ungagibela imizuzu engu-60 ubuningi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ake isikhathi sokugibela sibe yimizuzu engu-x futhi inani libe ngu-y원. Ngizokunika idatha ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi.

y-m-24-02.prereq.0: Ukufaka izinombolo emthethweni obhalwe njengesisho somugqa ukuthola inani
y-m-24-02.prereq.1: Ukuqonda ukuthi uhlamvu u-x lumelela inani esimweni, njengo-'isikhathi sokugibela (imizuzu)'
y-m-24-02.s.s1.prompt: Bheka idatha ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi futhi uhlulele ukuthi uhlelo luni oluyishibhile. Kulungile uma isahlulelo sakho sishintsha.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kudatha ngayinye, bala futhi ubhale umehluko phakathi kuka-A no-B, futhi ubheke ukuthi lowo mehluko ushintsha kanjani njengoba idatha ishintsha.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.1: Uma uhlangabezana neseli elingahambisani nesahlulelo sakho, esikhundleni sokushintsha isahlulelo sakho, cabanga ukuthi yisiphi isimo esingenza lifanele.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Lena ingxenye yethebula lamanani. Uma ugibela imizuzu engu-0 (ukhokha kuphela inani eliyisisekelo), u-A ungu-1000원 futhi u-B ungu-400원. Uma ugibela imizuzu engu-10, u-A ungu-2500원 futhi u-B ungu-2400원.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uma ubuka kuphela le migqa emibili, yiluphi uhlelo ongasho ukuthi lushibhile uma ugibela isikhathi eside?
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Kulungile ukubikezela kusukela kumumo ukuthi umehluko uyancipha, njengo-c, futhi kulungile nokuhlehlisa ukwahlulela, njengo-d. Kodwa u-'B uhlala eshibhile' akahambisani neqiniso lokuthi umehluko uyancipha.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Noma ugibela isikhathi eside, u-B uhlala eshibhile
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ubheke kuphela iqiniso lokuthi u-B wayeshibhile emaseleni amabili. Awubhekanga iqiniso lokuthi umehluko phakathi kwamanani amabili washintsha usuka ku-600원 uya ku-100원.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Uma ugibela isikhathi eside, u-A uhlala eshibhile kuno-B
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Usho okuphambene noma ithebula libonisa amaseli lapho u-B eshibhile. Ungathola isizathu ethebuleni?

y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ufunde umumo womehluko phakathi kwamanani amabili uncipha futhi wabikezela ngokucophelela ushintsho oluzayo.
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kunamaseli amabili kuphela, ngakho asikwazi ukusho ukuthi yimuphi oshibhile
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Lesi yisahlulelo sokucophelela esivuma ukuthi idatha incane. Ungasasebenzisa ushintsho lomehluko osukwazi ukulubona.

y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Inani eliyisisekelo luka-B lishibhile ngo-600 won, ngakho linxuse u-B kuwo wonke ogibela imizuzu engu-8 kuya ku-15
y-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wahlulele ngenani eliyisisekelo kuphela. Waphuthelwa ukuthi umehluko wenani ngomzuzu uyaqongelela njengoba isikhathi sikhula.

y-m-24-05.title: Uma wazi iphoyinti elilodwa kuphela, ingabe umsebenzi omaqondana unqunyiwe?
y-m-24-05.topic: Isibalo negrafu yomsebenzi omaqondana: ukwenza izibalo ezanelisa izimo
y-m-24-05.goal: Qonda ngokwenza izibalo wena ukuthi uma izimo zishoda kungaba khona izibalo eziningana ezingenzeka, ukuthi ziba ezimbalwa lapho kungezwa izimo, nokuthi ezinye izimo azenzeki.
y-m-24-05.material: Igrafu yomsebenzi omaqondana y=ax+b (a iyinombolo engeyona u-0) ingumugqa oqondile. UJimin uthe, "Uma wazi kuphela ukuthi ugrafu udlula ephoyintini (2, 5), isibalo salo msebenzi omaqondana sinqunywa njengesisodwa kuphela!" (Ukufunda: iphoyinti (2, 5) liyiphoyinti lapho y ingu-5 lapho x ingu-2. I-x-intercept i-x-coordinate yephoyinti lapho ugrafu uhlangana khona ne-x-axis.)
y-m-24-05.prereq.0: Ukuthi a no-b emsebenzini omaqondana y=ax+b zisho ini ngesimo segrafu (ibanga lesigaba somsebenzi omaqondana webanga lesi-8)
y-m-24-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ku-a=1, b=3, faka x=2 esibalweni bese uhlola ukuthi sidlula ephoyintini (2, 5).
y-m-24-05.s.s1.hint.1: Shintsha u-a ube ezinye izinombolo, lungisa b ukuze ifanele, bese ubala ukuthi zingaki izibalo ezidlula ephoyintini ezivelayo.
y-m-24-05.s.s1.o.a: Kunqunyiwe. Kusuka ezixhumanisini zephoyinti elilodwa ungathola bobabili a no-b

Ku-나, u-3 no-2 ku-3x+2y basemayunithini amashumi ezinkulungwane ze-won kodwa u-24000 usemayunithini e-won, ngakho akuhambisani, futhi ku-라 izimali zabadala nezezingane zishintshisiwe ngakho x=6, y=4 iyaphuma futhi amanani abadala nezingane ayaphenduka.
y-m-24-03.s.s1.acc.0: 가 ulungile. Hlola ukuthi 다 nawo uyisibalo esibhala isimo esifanayo ngamayunithi amashumi ezinkulungwane ze-won. Noma amayunithi ebonakala ehlukile, angachaza isimo esifanayo.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.prompt: Bhala indlela yokubonisa, ngaphandle kokuxazulula izibalo ezimaqondana, ukuthi isibalo sesibili sika-나, 3x+2y=24000, asihambisani nalesi simo.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngenani elikhulu kakhulu uhlangothi lwesobunxele lwesibalo sesibili sika-나 olungalithatha, uma x+y=10.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi izinombolo 3, 2, no-24000 zikuyiphi iyunithi ngayinye.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale okungenani isizathu esisodwa esibonisa ukuthi isibalo asilungile ngaphandle kokuxazulula?
y-m-24-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ungasho ukuthi isizathu osibhalile sikhuluma ngo-'mayunithi' noma 'usayizi'?
y-m-24-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange nangendlela yokuphinda ubhale, njengo-가 noma 다?
y-m-24-03.s.s2.model.0: Uma x+y=10, khona x no-y zombili ziyi-10 noma ngaphansi, ngakho 3x+2y ingu-30 ubuningi. Kodwa ayikwazi ukuba ngu-24000, ngakho 나 ayihambisani nalesi simo.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.model.1: Ku-3x, u-3 usemayunithini amashumi ezinkulungwane ze-won kodwa u-24000 usemayunithini e-won, ngakho amayunithi ahlukile. Uma ubhala 3000x+2000y=24000 noma ushintsha u-24000 ube ngu-24, kuba yisibalo esilungile.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Isebenzise amayunithi njengesizathu futhi yabhala nokuthi ungasilungisa kanjani.

y-m-24-06.title: Isamba sezikwele ezine ekhalendeni: isitatimende sikaJiyun silungile kangakanani?
y-m-24-06.topic: Izibalo ezinezinhlamvu: ukuchaza isamba sezinombolo ekhalendeni
y-m-24-06.goal: Vuselela umthetho owakhiwe ngezibonelo ezimbalwa usebenzisa idatha entsha, setha isibalo esinezinhlamvu ukuhlola ukuthi umthetho ubamba ngaphansi kwesiphi isimo, bese wenza izibonelo zesinye isimo ngendlela efanayo.
y-m-24-06.material: Ikhalenda linezikwele ezingu-7 emugqeni (iSonto kuya kuMgqibelo), le nyanga inezinsuku ezingu-31, futhi u-1 uwuSonto. Ngakho u-1 kuya ku-7 ngumugqa wokuqala futhi u-8 kuya ku-14 ngumugqa wesibili. Uma ukhetha ibhulokhi elingu-2×2 lezikwele (izikwele ezi-2 ngokuhlangana nezi-2 ngokuhlala phansi) kuleli khalenda, uthola izinombolo ezine. UJiyun uthe, "Uma wengeza izinombolo ezine zebhulokhi elingu-2×2, njalo iyisikhathi sika-8!"
y-m-24-06.thinking.1: Ukuvuselela umthetho onezimo usebenzisa idatha entsha
y-m-24-06.prereq.0: Isipiliyoni sokubhala isimo njengesibalo usebenzisa izinhlamvu (isibonelo: ukubhala izinombolo ezilandelanayo njengo-a, a+1)
y-m-24-06.s.s1.prompt: Hlola isitatimende sikaJiyun kanye nedatha entsha.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kudatha ngayinye, maka ukuthi inombolo esikwele esiphezulu kwesokunxele iyinombolo eyisibili noma eyodwa.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.hint.1: Uma kuvela idatha engafaneli isinqumo sakho, bala futhi ukuhlola, bese unquma ukuthi uzisibuyekeza kanjani isinqumo sakho.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.info: UJiyun uhlole kathathu. Uma isikwele esiphezulu kwesokunxele singumhla we-2, engeza 2, 3, 9, 10 uthole 24. Uma singumhla we-10, engeza 10, 11, 17, 18 uthole 56. Uma singumhla we-12, engeza 12, 13, 19, 20 uthole 64. Zonke izikhathi ezintathu iyinombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-8.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ungamethemba kangakanani isitatimende sikaJiyun ('njalo iyinombolo eyizikhathi eziningi ze-8')?
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Izibonelo ezintathu ziyasekela umthetho, kodwa akukho siqinisekiso sokuthi umthetho ofanayo uyasebenza kuzo zonke izindawo. Kufanele futhi uqaphele ukuthi izikwele eziphezulu kwesokunxele bezingu-2, 10 no-12 (zonke ziyizinombolo eziyisibili).
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Bekulungile kathathu, ngakho singakwethemba ukuthi kuhlala kunjalo
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uguqule ukuhlola okuthathu kwaba 'njalo'. Awubhekanga ukuthi yiziphi izindawo ezihloliwe.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kubukeka kulungile, kodwa izindawo ezintathu kuphela ezihloliwe, ngakho kusenesikhathi sokuqiniseka
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uqaphele ukuthi izibonelo ziyasekela umthetho kodwa aziwuqinisekisi.
